_comment: The six floor anchors in VICON metres, from the layout recording that this scene was registered against -- the frame vicon_transform.json is fitted in. The fit itself used A2, A3, A4, A5, A6; A1 produced no usable rays and is carried here only as a drift reference. Record them again at the start of a flight session and compare with splat_hitl.anchors.drift: this frame has already moved once, by 0.66 deg, with nobody touching the system.
